messages:
talia: flagging a host-side perf blip after yesterday's kernel-selector roll. pprof shows most time in http/gRPC header decode and pretokenize scan. small writev count also spiked.

omar: can you paste the flame? wondering if batching heuristics changed.

talia: ```
25%  http2_read_frames
19%  grpc_decode_headers
13%  pretokenize_scan
8%   kvcache.lookup
6%   writev (many <512B iovecs)
```

sophie: saw kv miss rate up on mobile path too (4% -> ~9%). likely kernel variant changed alignment/prefix layout.

kai: that + smaller minibatch hints -> more per-request work and more fragmented frames. two immediate mitigations: ingress coalesce (buffer up to 2KB / 5ms) and selector bias fallback to previous kernel for affected hostgroups.

matt: i'll own the selector-bias PR (adds metric gate: per-worker small_write_rate > 300/s => fallback).

talia: omar/sophie can prototype the coalesce shim? lightweight rust sidecar feature-flagged.

omar: yep, will do. adding a microbench: emit headers+payload split into 64/128/256 bytes and measure parse cpu + writev count across kernels.

sophie: i'll add kv key-histogram to see distribution shifts and a per-request writev_count histogram for alerting.

sre-bot: created incident INC-2026-044 (host-ingress-parse-uplift) linked to thread 6550023456

matt: thanks. canary plan: route 2% mobile traffic to previous kernel on hostgroup=mobile-canary, measure p99/cpu/writev for 30m.

talia: started canary. initial 15m: canary hosts show -24ms p99 and ~5% less CPU, writev drop ~60%. will update after 30m.

kai: also adding perf-ci microbench and a guard unit test asserting typical requests have <=8 writev iovecs. prevents regressions later.

omar: will send coalesce PR behind ff in ~3h.

talia: thanks all. creating tracking issue INF-2460 and assigning owners.
